captions.detailed: A simplified, modern white scale or bread maker base with four small cylindrical feet at its base. It features a raised, square-shaped top platform with a hollowed-out center, revealing a dark blue interior pane. The main body has rounded vertical corners and a uniform matte white finish.
captions.instruction: Create a simplified, clean white countertop appliance scale or base. The design should feature a solid rectangular body with rounded vertical corners, four small cylindrical feet at the bottom corners, and a raised square platform on top with a central rectangular cutout revealing a dark blue interior window.
captions.factory: Construct the main body using a Box primitive with filleted vertical edges. Create the four feet using Cylinder primitives placed at the bottom corners. For the top platform, create a smaller Box with a central rectangular pocket cut out, filleting its outer edges, and place a dark blue-colored thin Box inside to represent the window glass.
